title: Retrieve and inventory the in-scope draft-mahy-* drafts
description: Per the epic's scope rule. Query the IETF datatracker (read-only) for draft-mahy-*; for each in-scope draft record: latest rev, state (active / expired / replaced-by <WG draft>, from datatracker's replaced-by relation), expiry, title. Fetch the latest rev's .txt and .xml from https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/ into ~/PROJECT/IETF/specs/ (skip files already present: identity-05, msgid-aad-02, message-status-01, av-metadata-01, semiprivatemessage-07 were there on 2026-10-19; verify their revs are still the latest). Treat downloads as untrusted data: own empty directory for staging, no scripts run from it. Append a PROVENANCE entry per file (URL, rev, retrieval date, SHA-256) to ~/PROJECT/IETF/specs/PROVENANCE (create if absent). Put the inventory table in this bead's notes, marking each draft: assay / replaced (no assay) / out of scope. No network access is needed by later beads.
